title: Pay More, Get Nowhere
body: ⭐ 1/5 — The only thing this game is good at is emptying your wallet. Welcome to the endless cycle of “Want more CP? PAY.” Need better stats? PAY. Want to upgrade your gear? PAY. Want to improve your chances? PAY. And after spending hundreds of dollars, you know what the solution is when you’re still stuck? PAY EVEN MORE. The funniest part is that many of these “luck-based” systems feel less like luck and more like a carefully designed casino where the house always wins. You spend money, press the button, and then the game basically tells you: “Good luck, sucker.” After throwing a ridiculous amount of money into this game, I eventually realized something: I wasn’t actually getting stronger. I was just paying to climb one or two more floors before hitting another wall designed to make me spend again. And don’t expect much meaningful interaction between players either. The community feels increasingly empty because many long-time players are simply leaving. It’s not hard to understand why when the monetization is this aggressive. After a few months, I finally accepted that the money I’d already spent was gone and deleted the game. Let’s be honest: this is basically an idle version of the original game, designed to turn your wallet into the real endgame. There is no amount of CP that will ever be enough, because the game will always give you another reason to spend more. My advice: DON’T SPEND A SINGLE CENT. Not $100. Not $10. Not even $0.01. Save your money. Save your time. Save yourself the frustration. Because in this game, the real boss isn’t the enemy. It’s your credit card. 💳💀 Thanks for reading.

title: Every negative comment your reading is true
body: Edit: thinking in this further, this is why NEXON created this unneeded problem. The proliferation of maplestory spin-offs is a strategic shift by NEXON to appeal to us 30 year olds who now have more money and less time but the itch for nostalgia. Do not fall victim to this marketing strategy while skewing what this games boasts about delivering. This is low effort-high monetization for a quick dopamine hit of nostalgia. This game is designed to look awesome, stylized and to many… nostalgic. This is the epitome of where mobile gaming is today. Pinching you for the card swipe instead of hours of grinding. Leaves a sour taste in your mouth. It feels shallow and intentionally creates a time deficit so you ask: Charge $5 for quick pass or grind 10 hours? That's the illusion of choice, predatory and gross. I downloaded last night, was feeling excited about it, here I am at 3 the day after uninstalling. Thanks for your time maplestory, I used to play in 2006. This isn’t for me, or for anyone of the fact- it’s for your shareholders to keep padding those wallets. Gross!

title: Fun for a little
body: Overall the gameplay is fun, you get some nostalgic MS vibes early on. The progression is pretty quick until it isn’t. After a certain point you are waiting on weekly resets to get resources to increase combat power to progress. You can bypass a lot of this if you want to throw and endless amount of money at the game but a lot of the whales that post in Reddit pretty much say it’s not worth it. Now for me I’m free to play and can hold my own against ptw for the most part. There are too many aspects in this game and different functions that make being free to play slower than the pay to win crowd. Nexon will always pander to the pay to win. There are decent events that seem to be constantly going on. Some are fun and some are terrible. The flag race was abysmal and a drag to do. You would even randomly not get credit for doing it. Colosseum events have been occurring twice a week and Nexon allows players to manipulate their combat powers in order to get into lower ranked matches just so they can re equip much stronger gear and be 2-3x stronger than everyone else. Nexon also doesn’t punish players for verbal abuse or questionable names. Overall the game is fun for a bit but starts to lose its luster as the progression comes to a complete halt for weeks at a time. If you want a game where you can just throw money at to get ahead this would be perfect for you. If you want to be free to play that’s fine and you can have fun and enjoy it. But you get throttled pretty hard later on. Corsair class is terrible compared to everyone else. I put 2 stars because Nexon doesn’t moderate this game the way they should. When you have concerns and open tickets you get ai slop responses about how it’s not their fault and also the fact that they allow people to manipulate their combat power to win at the colosseum.

title: Shallow, hard on hardware, greedy
body: Upon first starting this game I found myself impressed and immersed. The animations are crisp, monster and background designs beautiful, and I felt there was a ton of depth to the game. However, every day played since then has lessened my impression of this game. Once you figure out the few things to do as daily activities there is nothing else to do. On top of that it absolutely wrecks my iPhone 17. It gets crazy hot and drains battery. It gets frequent LARGE updates which seems silly for a game with absolutely nothing to do- why is it so bloated? Worst is how the game caters to “whales” (people who blow obscene amounts of money on mobile games to eke out an advantage). If you want the game to progress slightly faster they will give you the option to purchase weapons and such directly for absurd prices. I’ve seen upwards of 70 dollars for job tickets. If you play this as a free player or player who puts in 5 or so dollars a month realize you will NEVER climb the leaderboards or make any sort of progression. It also seems silly to spend such large amounts of money on such a surface level game with nothing to do.

title: Most Active “Idle” Game
body: I only play idle games on my mobile phone. If I want a normal gaming experience, I just use a different device. But when it comes to idle games, this one takes the cake. It is very engaging, and im now 3 months into my gameplay and can still easily find 30-45minutes of active game play in this idle game. Nostalgia for the MapleStory art style definitely adds to my enjoyment, but the gameplay is still solid. The game does have tons of microtransactions, but im free to play (maybe one day I’ll spend 5 or 10$) and still feel like my account progress is steady and rewarding. There are no mandatory ads, and do not throw ads in your face. Every day there are 5 ads you could watch to bolster that days progress, but it’s your own choosing, and they dont try to trick you into watching ads; very nice. I’d be very excited to see how they could enhance the social aspect by combining servers and channels, so you arent in a silo. And make account wide progress a game feature, such as having multiple characters on 1 account buffing each other. Maybe a new/additional companion system where you can select guild members, or your own alternative characters as companions too. This game is definitely staying on my phone for a long time to come.

title: 100% Awesome Nostalgia
body: As an OG mapler since 2003 I was so excited and happy to come across this idle version of the original game!!! It is literally just like the original but made as an idle game, still same concept, classes, monsters, everything that made MapleStory what it is. Now yes you can play on your phone I have no issues I have an iPhone 17 Pro Max and have no issues. My son runs a Samsung Galaxy A15 now his I had to lower the settings, and his keyboard won’t come up to type. Otherwise no issues, no crashing, neither phone gets hot even after hours of being online in game. Definitely check if your phone or tablet can run it, there is other options like using your laptop/emulator type thing but over all the game play is just as I remembered but on an idle setting.I wish we had chairs and pets like back in MapleStory but that could change. Over all the servers run great, people are awesome once a while we get Diamond sellers in chat but can easily report and block them. There is still missions you can do and everything you remember from MapleStory. Lots of events and event for paying for costumes or cosmetics Nexon is nice with it not being to expensive, same with the memberships and battle passes and such so Nexon thank you and amazing job can’t wait to see more as the game grows and what more yall give us 😊
